title: Use multiple adopter catalogs for conformance
summary: Use public or synthetic fixtures from README-HQ-style manual catalogs, Veraphify maps, and other project layouts to test install, navigation, and upgrades against real differences.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Finds differences that a blank starter test cannot cover.
risks: Passing one adopter fixture can be misread as compatibility with every host.
Fixtures can contain information unsuitable for public CI.

evidence.claim: README-HQ uses a dedicated catalog branch for project-owned records.
Veraphify documents a working adopter-side map.
